# Specification Quality Checklist: Personal Finance Manager

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of `spec.md` before the `review-spec` gate and `/speckit.plan`. Every item interrogates what the specification _says_, not what the future implementation will do.
**Created**: 2026-09-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · **Governing document**: [constitution.md](../../../.specify/memory/constitution.md) v1.0.0

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the seeded catalogue of 10–12 categories enumerated by name and type, given that FR-025 requires the seed to be deterministic? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-025]
- [x] CHK002 Are maximum lengths defined for account, category and project names, as FR-005 defines one for transaction descriptions? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK003 Is an upper bound specified for any monetary amount (transaction, opening balance, scheduled amount, project budget)? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, §FR-022]
- [x] CHK004 Does FR-016's attribute list for a scheduled item include the description that FR-005 and the Key Entities section both require of it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK005 Are the scheduled-item validation rules stated as requirements, rather than appearing only in an acceptance scenario? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, §US4 AS-10]
- [x] CHK006 Is the rejection of a project on an income or a transfer specified to use the structured error shape, as FR-008 does for transactions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, §FR-023]
- [x] CHK007 Does the Entry entity definition carry the date that FR-011 depends on to compute a balance as of a date? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK008 Is it specified under which intent a transaction has more than two entries, given the Key Entities definition permits it? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK009 Are requirements defined for the system account that backs each category, including what creating or archiving a category implies for it? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities, §FR-003]

## Requirement Clarity & Ambiguity

- [x] CHK010 Is the "stable secondary key" that makes FR-009's ordering deterministic across pages named? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK011 Is "the current total" the projection starts from defined as FR-010's total across non-archived accounts? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK012 Is the number of overdue occurrences a recurring item contributes defined — exactly one, or one per missed period? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Is FR-014's normalisation defined for a description that normalises to an empty string, such as one made only of digits? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK014 Is "N = 5 by default" specified as fixed or configurable, and by what mechanism? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014, §US6 AS-2]
- [x] CHK015 Does the spec state whether expenses on archived accounts are counted in the monthly report and in project spend? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-013, §FR-021]
- [x] CHK016 Are the date ranges accepted by FR-011 and FR-014 bounded, as FR-017 bounds the projection horizon at 24 months? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, §FR-014, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK017 Is the cached balance layer constrained enough that "every cached balance" in FR-031 denotes a finite, enumerable set? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012, §FR-031, §Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency & Conflicts

- [x] CHK018 Does FR-026's prohibition on raw cents in an "export" conflict with data export being listed out of scope? [Conflict, Spec §FR-026, §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK019 Does FR-019's "archiving, unarchiving" for projects conflict with the close/reopen vocabulary used for projects everywhere else? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, §FR-030]
- [x] CHK020 Is SC-002's "sum of all ledger entries" reconciled with FR-011's "non-deleted entries" on whether soft-deleted entries remain in the database and inside the global check? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002, §FR-007, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK021 Does SC-006 reference requirements that actually enumerate invalid requests, given FR-016 and FR-020 list none? [Conflict, Spec §SC-006, §FR-016, §FR-020]
- [x] CHK022 Is FR-008's rejection of archived-account references reconciled with editing a transaction that already references an account archived afterwards? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK023 Is FR-009's pagination rule stated to apply, or not to apply, to the category drill-down of FR-013 and the project expense list of FR-021? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §FR-013, §FR-021]
- [x] CHK024 Do "archived", "closed", "active flag" and "status" map to one consistently used lifecycle vocabulary across FR-004, FR-016, FR-019 and Key Entities? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities]

## Acceptance Criteria & Measurability

- [x] CHK025 Does SC-008 define whether its budget is an API or an end-to-end UI measurement, at which percentile, and over which named screens and endpoints? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK026 Does SC-007's five-minute target state the machine, the network and whether container image pulls count towards it? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK027 Can SC-003's "with and without cached values present" be executed — does any requirement provide a way to read balances bypassing the cache? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK028 Are success criteria defined for FR-014, FR-019 and FR-021, which no SC currently covers? [Coverage, Spec §SC-001–SC-012]
- [x] CHK029 Is a success criterion defined for FR-015's integration path, given narrative accuracy is explicitly excluded as a criterion? [Gap, Spec §FR-015, §SC-001–SC-012]
- [x] CHK030 Is the 15–20 minute walkthrough defined as a concrete step list, so SC-001 and SC-012 measure the same flow? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-012]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK031 Are requirements defined for what happens when the FR-031 reconciliation check fails against a live database? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §FR-031]
- [x] CHK032 Are requirements defined for what the user sees when a mutation succeeds but the FR-028 refetch fails? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK033 Does the "last write wins" decision address whether the FR-012 cache can be left disagreeing with entries under concurrent writes? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK034 Are requirements defined for editing or deleting a transaction that was materialised from a scheduled item? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018, §US4 AS-9]
- [x] CHK035 Are requirements defined for a scheduled item whose end date falls before its next due date? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK036 Are requirements defined for changing an account's opening date or kind once transactions exist? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-001, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK037 Is each behaviour stated only in the Edge Cases section (page beyond the end, zero opening balance, month-end clamping, amount precision, empty states) traceable to a functional requirement? [Traceability, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements Quality

- [x] CHK038 Is FR-034's accessibility floor stated in terms a reviewer can check by hand, given the automated suite is out of scope? [Measurability, Spec §FR-034, §SC-012]
- [x] CHK039 Does FR-033's ban on logging transaction content define which fields are forbidden, given FR-023's error details may echo submitted field values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-033, §FR-023]

## Dependencies, Assumptions & Environment

- [x] CHK040 Are all the assumptions the specification takes stated in one dated list and accepted by the reviewer before the plan freezes the contract? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK041 Are the environment variables the spec introduces (timezone, log level, LLM provider key, LLM timeout) enumerated with names and defaults? [Gap, Spec §FR-015, §FR-029, §FR-033]
- [x] CHK042 Is the external LLM provider documented as a dependency with its failure modes stated as requirements rather than only as an edge case? [Dependency, Spec §FR-015, §Edge Cases]

## Constitutional Traceability (Principles I–VII)

- [x] CHK043 Does FR-006 state both enforcement points — domain and database constraint — inside one atomic write, as Principle I requires? [Traceability, Spec §FR-006, Const §I]
- [x] CHK044 Do the requirements make the cached balance layer reconcilable and rebuildable from entries alone, as Principle I requires of any derived balance? [Traceability, Spec §FR-012, §FR-031, Const §I]
- [x] CHK045 Is the rule that only one translation point produces entries stated in the spec itself, or does it exist only in the constitution? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, §FR-024, Const §III]
- [x] CHK046 Are the four supported intents named consistently with Principle III across FR-005, FR-007 and the Key Entities section? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-007, Const §III]
- [x] CHK047 Do the requirements stay at intent level without pre-empting the OpenAPI contract and Prisma schema that Principle IV freezes in the plan phase? [Traceability, Spec §Requirements, Const §IV]
- [x] CHK048 Does FR-023 define one error shape for the whole API without contradicting Principle V, which fixes where errors are mapped to HTTP? [Traceability, Spec §FR-023, Const §V]
- [x] CHK049 Is each domain behaviour Principle VI requires tests for — every intent, sum-to-zero rejection, balance as of a date, projection — expressed as a requirement in the spec? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, §FR-011, §FR-017, Const §VI]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items resolved by editing `spec.md` should be re-run through `/speckit-clarify` when they change a decision rather than only its wording
- This checklist is the `review-spec` gate input; it does not approve the gate
